method: Repository inspection of routes, pages, services, models, and customer-facing copy. No runtime product analytics.

items.name: Marketing landing page
items.customer_outcome: Understand the promise and open sign-up or sign-in

items.name: Email and password sign-up
items.customer_outcome: Create an account and receive a session cookie

items.name: Sign-in
items.customer_outcome: Return to the account for 12 hours

items.name: Email verification
items.notes: Signup is open. docs/planning/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW_FOLLOWUP_PLAN.md says email verification is not part of that plan.

items.name: Financial profile creation
items.customer_outcome: Store age, monthly income, expenses, savings, optional EMI, risk, and a free-text goal

items.name: Edit a saved profile
items.notes: Profiles can be created and deleted. No update route or edit form was found.

items.name: Delete a profile
items.notes: Delete works. No confirmation dialog was found.

items.name: Several profiles on one account
items.notes: Whether a profile means a person, a household member, or a scenario is UNKNOWN. The title shown is the goal text.

items.name: Seven-pillar financial health score
items.notes: The score is rule-based and does not call the model. The customer sees it only after an AI report job succeeds. The dashboard empty state says to generate a report to unlock the score.

items.name: AI advisory report
items.customer_outcome: A written report grounded in the profile and the health score, one saved report per profile

items.name: PDF download
items.notes: Text can be saved when the PDF file is not ready. The customer is told to download to build it.

items.name: Advisor chat
items.notes: History is stored per profile. The model sees the profile and a recent slice of that chat. Suggested prompts exist.

items.name: Goal feasibility simulator
items.notes: Runs in the request with static CAGR tiers and Indian product names. The result is kept in browser memory for the profile, not in the database. The screen labels the rule-based score as Pilot AI Confidence Score. Balanced is always marked Recommended in the UI.

items.name: Live market data for CAGR
items.notes: README roadmap item. The calculator uses fixed tiers.

items.name: Background report and chat jobs
items.notes: The customer sees Generating or Analyzing, then a result or a failure. A separate worker process must be running.

items.name: Usage quotas
items.notes: Defaults include 5 report generations per minute and 10 per hour per profile, and 15 chats per minute and 60 per hour per profile. The customer is told to wait, not what the allowance is.

items.name: Scoped API keys
items.notes: Issued by a script. Not exposed in the React app.

items.name: Search
items.notes: A search field is rendered in the top bar. No search behavior was found.

items.name: Notifications
items.notes: A notification icon is rendered. It has no action. No notification store was found.

items.name: Settings
items.notes: A settings icon is rendered. It has no action. No settings page was found.

items.name: Upgrade to Elite
items.notes: A button is rendered in the sidebar. It has no action. No plan, price, or billing implementation was found. No planning document naming Elite was found.

items.name: Billing and plans
items.notes: Landing copy says Create your free account. No payment provider was found.

items.name: Financial disclaimers
items.notes: Advisory page and the PDF carry a short disclaimer. Chat says the AI can make mistakes. Goals and the landing page do not carry that advisory disclaimer. Legal sufficiency is UNKNOWN and needs legal review.

items.name: Product analytics
items.notes: No product analytics SDK was found in the frontend.

items.name: Bank or account aggregation
items.notes: Figures are typed by the customer. No aggregator was found.
